# openmetadata_file (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata file. Files are the objects stored inside the directories of a drive service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_drive_service" "google_drive" {
  name         = "google-drive"
  service_type = "GoogleDrive"
}

resource "openmetadata_directory" "reports" {
  name        = "reports"
  service     = openmetadata_drive_service.google_drive.name
  description = "Shared finance reports."
}

resource "openmetadata_file" "quarterly" {
  name         = "quarterly-report"
  service      = openmetadata_drive_service.google_drive.name
  directory    = openmetadata_directory.reports.fully_qualified_name
  display_name = "Quarterly report"
  description  = "Quarterly finance report as a PDF."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) File name. Changing it replaces the file, because the name is part of its fully qualified name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent drive service. Changing it replaces the file.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the file.
- `directory` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent directory. Changing it replaces the file.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name, in the form service.directory.name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_file.quarterly 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, in the form service.directory.name.
terraform import openmetadata_file.quarterly google-drive.reports.quarterly-report
```
